summary: All 20 retained files matched their manifest hashes and sizes. Seven of eight calculations reproduced. Batch-28 had five control pups, bringing the total to 50 control and 38 ELA pups, in agreement with the dissection text. [Supplementary Table S1, page 5](https://pmc-oa-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/PMC9874075.1/mmc1.pdf). The corrected proposal also records the historical GEO metadata checksum difference and two gene-identifier discrepancies. It passes the proposal validator and retains needs_author_contact because the 254 tested neurons cannot be linked individually to the 602 deposited cells.
openIssues: The cell IDs and treatment assignments for the 511-cell QC set and the 254-neuron analysis remain unresolved. The reported control/ELA splits are 101/153 and 102/152.
Both count-based QC checks yield 514 cells. B19, B21 and L12 each have one more qualifying cell than Table S1 reports.
The Rpl10 and Hspa8 entries in the indexed dissertation table require identifier reconciliation before gene-level comparison.
